tokens.v: Put him small in the left third, mid-step out of deep blue shade into a hard-edged wedge of late sun, so the gum sole and toe cap ignite first while his torso still sits two stops down. 24mm at f/5.6 from pavement level, lens a hand's width off the ground, tilted up so the wall towers. A lifted sheet of torn poster paper flares out of focus in the near-right foreground, cut by the right and bottom edges. The blank panel holds clean far right. Cropped technical jacket zipped to the sternum over a white tee, wide black trousers cropped at the ankle.
